primaries.description: Higher engineering skill allows you to learn higher level engineering schematics.  Schematics can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.
primaries.name: Engineering

primaries.description: Higher enchanting skill allows you to learn more powerful formulae.  Formulae can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and monsters.
primaries.name: Enchanting

secondaries.description: Higher cooking skill allows you to learn higher level cooking recipes.  Recipes can be found on trainers around the world as well as from quests and as drops from monsters.
secondaries.name: Cooking

raids.description: The Dreamrift exists deep within the Rift of Aln, where the dreams of Aln'hara took form long ago. Dark manifestations have grown within the rift in Aln'hara's absence, devouring each other in an endless cycle. Even the brave haranir dare not delve too deep, for now something greater and more terrible lurks within the Dreamrift's depths.
raids.name: The Dreamrift
raids.title: The Dreamrift
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: From high above the Voidstorm, Xal'atath has gathered the Devouring Host beneath her dark banner. The towering Voidspire looms like a spear of darkness, a citadel guarded by an army of the void. The forces of the light - led by Alleria Windrunner and the Champions of Azeroth - must rally for one last desperate assault before all is lost.
raids.name: The Voidspire
raids.title: The Voidspire
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Darkness has eclipsed the Isle of Quel'Danas, clouding the skies above Silvermoon City. With Arator the Redeemer by their side, the Champions of Azeroth must march on the Sunwell before the light of the blood elves is lost forever.
raids.name: March on Quel'Danas
raids.title: March on Quel'Danas
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Deep in the fungal valleys of Harandar, the fungarian sporecallers have been growing a new threat for The Grudge Pit. Shaded by towering mushrooms, Sporefall is the perfect site to empower their new creation.
raids.name: Sporefall
raids.title: Sporefall
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Guided by the dark whispers of Malacrass, Zul'jan has freed the forgotten broods of Ula'tek from their prison. As the monster's power grows, Zul'jarra calls upon the Champions of Azeroth to descend into the Vaults of Atal'Utek to stop her brother before the weapon is unleashed upon Azeroth.
raids.name: The Venomous Abyss
raids.title: The Venomous Abyss
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Hidden beneath the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Kith'ix was bound in his subterranean lair. With the defeat of Ula'tek, the restraints keeping Kith'ix at bay have weakened, unleashing the monstrosity the Amani locked away so long ago.
raids.name: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.title: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.subtitle: Level 90

specs.description:
A master of shadow magic who specializes in drains and damage-over-time spells.

Preferred Weapon: Staff, Wand, Dagger, Sword

classTalents.description: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus, Succubus, Felhunter, or Felguard Summon spell is free and has its casting time reduced by 90%.
classTalents.name: Fel Domination

classTalents.description:
Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.2% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 10% of maximum health.

Increases your armor by 90%.
classTalents.name: Demon Skin

classTalents.description:
When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 10% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.

Reduces damage taken by 3.0%.
classTalents.name: Fel Armor

classTalents.description: Stamina increased by 10%.
classTalents.name: Demonic Embrace

classTalents.description: Increases the amount of damage required to break your fear effects by 60%.
classTalents.name: Nightmare

classTalents.description: Increases you and your pets' maximum health by 5%.
classTalents.name: Demonic Fortitude

classTalents.description:
Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
classTalents.name: Curse of Exhaustion

classTalents.description:
Forces the target to speak in Demonic, increasing the casting time of all spells by 30% for 1 min.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
classTalents.name: Curse of Tongues

classTalents.description: Healing done by Drain Life also heals your primary demon at 400% effectiveness.
classTalents.name: Infernal Beneficiary

classTalents.description: Horrifies an enemy target into fleeing, incapacitating for 3 sec and healing you for 25% of maximum health.
classTalents.name: Mortal Coil

classTalents.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.
classTalents.name: Pact of the Annihilan

classTalents.description:
Summons a Demonic Circle for 15 min. Cast Demonic Circle: Teleport to teleport to its location and remove all movement slowing effects.

You also learn:

 Demonic Circle: Teleport
Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and removes all movement slowing effects.
classTalents.name: Demonic Circle

classTalents.description: Increases your haste by 2%.
classTalents.name: Pact of the Satyr

classTalents.description: Increases the range of Mortal Coil by 10 yds and Mortal Coil now heals for an additional 5% of maximum health.
classTalents.name: Improved Mortal Coil

classTalents.description: Sacrifices 5% of your current health to shield you for 800% of the sacrificed health plus an additional 6,255 for 20 sec. Usable while suffering from control impairing effects.
classTalents.name: Dark Pact

classTalents.description: Casting Curse of Exhaustion, Curse of Tongues, or Curse of Weakness now curses all enemies within 10 yds of the target.
classTalents.name: Foul Mouth

classTalents.description: Healthstones heal you for an additional 5% additional health.
classTalents.name: Empowered Healthstone

classTalents.description: Using Demonic Circle: Teleport or your Demonic Gateway reduces all damage you take by 4% for 10 sec.
classTalents.name: Abyss Walker

classTalents.description: Soul Leech may now absorb an additional 5% of your maximum health.
classTalents.name: Fortified Soul

classTalents.description:
Your primary pets gain a bonus effect.

Imp: Successful Singe Magic casts grant the target 4% damage reduction for 5 sec.

Voidwalker: Reduces the cooldown of Shadow Bulwark by 30 sec.

Felhunter: Reduces the cooldown of Devour Magic by 5 sec.

Sayaad: Reduces the cooldown of Seduction by 10 sec and causes the target to walk faster towards the demon.
classTalents.name: Teachings of the Black Harvest

classTalents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Dark Pact by 15 sec.
classTalents.name: Frequent Donor

classTalents.description: Increases your Intellect by 3%.
classTalents.name: Pact of the Eredar

classTalents.description: Reduces the chance you will be critically struck by 2%. All damage your primary demon takes is reduced by 8%.
classTalents.name: Demonic Resilience

classTalents.description: Unending Resolve reduces damage taken by an additional 15%.
classTalents.name: Strength of Will

classTalents.description: Creates a demonic gateway between two locations. Activating the gateway transports the user to the other gateway. Each player can use a Demonic Gateway only once per 90 sec.
classTalents.name: Demonic Gateway

classTalents.description: Let loose a terrifying howl, causing 10 enemies within 10 yds to flee in fear, disorienting them for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
classTalents.name: Howl of Terror

classTalents.description:
20% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. 

While Grimoire of Sacrifice is active, your Stamina is increased by 12%.
classTalents.name: Soul Link

classTalents.description: Reduces the cast time of Demonic Gateway by 0.5 sec and you can now use Demonic Gateways twice before triggering a cooldown.
classTalents.name: Frequent Traveler

classTalents.description:
Reduces the cooldown of Shadowfury by 15 sec and increases its radius by 2 yds.

Reduces the cooldown of Howl of Terror by 5 sec and it now fears 5 additional enemies.
classTalents.name: Oppressive Darkness

classTalents.description:
Healthstones you conjure for yourself are now Demonic Healthstones and can be used multiple times in combat. Demonic Healthstones cannot be traded.

 Demonic Healthstone
Instantly restores 30% health. 60 sec cooldown.
classTalents.name: Pact of Gluttony

classTalents.description:
Consumes a Soul Shard, unlocking the hidden power of your spells.

Demonic Circle: Teleport: Increases your movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

Demonic Gateway: Can be cast instantly.

Drain Life: Gain an absorb shield equal to the amount of healing done for 30 sec. This shield cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Healthstone: Increases the healing of your Healthstone by 30% and increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
classTalents.name: Soulburn

heroTalents.description: Fire damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Fire spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
heroTalents.name: Xalan's Ferocity

heroTalents.description:
If the target is afflicted with your Wither, casting Unstable Affliction increase its stack count by 1.

Each time Wither gains a stack it has a chance to collapse, consuming a stack every 1 sec to deal 8,364 Shadowflame damage to its host until 1 stack remains.
heroTalents.name: Blackened Soul

heroTalents.description: Shadow damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Shadow spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
heroTalents.name: Xalan's Cruelty

heroTalents.description:
Increases the damage of Unstable Affliction by 8% and Seed of Corruption by 4%.

This effect is doubled while Malevolence is active.
heroTalents.name: Through the Felvine

heroTalents.description: While Unending Resolve is active, enemies within 30 yds are affected by Curse of Tongues and Curse of Weakness at 100% effectiveness.
heroTalents.name: Aura of Enfeeblement

heroTalents.description: Wither damage increased 20%. When Wither gains a stack from Blackened Soul, it has a chance to gain an additional stack.
heroTalents.name: Bleakheart Tactics

heroTalents.description: Dark Pact heals you for 6,217 every 1 sec while active.
heroTalents.name: Zevrim's Resilience

heroTalents.description: Periodic damage dealt by Wither has a chance to grant Malevolence for 8 sec.
heroTalents.name: Devil Fruit

heroTalents.description:
Agony damage increased by 30%.

Blackened Soul deals 2% increased damage per stack of Wither.
heroTalents.name: Mark of Xavius

heroTalents.description:
After Wither reaches 8 stacks or when its host reaches 20% health, Wither deals 8,364 Shadowflame damage to its host every 1 sec until 1 stack remains.

When Blackened Soul deals damage, you have a chance to gain Shard Instability.
heroTalents.name: Seeds of Their Demise

heroTalents.description:
Damaging critical strikes dealt by Wither deal 215% damage instead of the usual 200%.

Damaging critical strikes dealt by Blackened Soul deal 225% damage instead of the usual 200%.
heroTalents.name: Mark of Peroth'arn

heroTalents.description: Malevolence grants an additional 4% Haste and when cast increases the stack count of active Withers by an additional 2 stacks.
heroTalents.name: Alzzin's Iniquity

heroTalents.description:
Dark magic erupts from you and corrupts your soul for 20 sec, causing enemies suffering from your Wither to take 39,395 Shadowflame damage and increase its stack count by 6.

While corrupted your Haste is increased by 8% and spending Soul Shards on damaging spells grants 1 additional stack of Wither.
heroTalents.name: Malevolence

specTalents.description:
Inflicts increasing agony on the target, causing up to 74,469 Shadow damage over 18 sec. Damage starts low and increases over the duration. Refreshing Agony maintains its current damage level.

Agony damage sometimes generates 1 Soul Shard.
specTalents.name: Agony

specTalents.description:
Afflicts the target with 33,302 Shadow damage over 8 sec. Multiple uses of this ability may overlap.

If dispelled, deals 323,860 damage to the dispeller and silences them for 4 sec. This damage is increased by 15% per stack on the target.

Generates 1 Soul Shard if the target dies while afflicted.
specTalents.name: Unstable Affliction

specTalents.description:
Embeds a demon seed in the enemy target that will explode after 9.4 sec, dealing 10,801 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yards and applying Corruption to them. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

The seed will detonate early if the target is hit by other detonations, or takes 1,251 damage from your spells.
specTalents.name: Seed of Corruption

specTalents.description:
Corruption damage has a chance to cause your next Drain Soul or Malefic Grasp to deal 75% increased damage. 

Drain Soul and Malefic Grasp channel 50% faster while affected.
specTalents.name: Nightfall

specTalents.description:
A ghostly soul haunts a single target, dealing 59,963 Shadow damage and increasing your damage dealt to the target by 20% for 18 sec.

While active, Haunt deals 66,430 Shadow damage to its host and 3 enemies within 10 yards suffering from your Corruption or Wither. If the target dies, Haunt's cooldown is reset.
specTalents.name: Haunt

specTalents.description: Increases Agony damage by 10% and Agony now hits another nearby enemy within 15 yds of the target.
specTalents.name: Shared Agony

specTalents.description: Reduces the cast time of Shadow Bolt by 15% and increases its damage by 40%.
specTalents.name: Improved Shadow Bolt

specTalents.description: Increases the damage of Haunt by 35% and reduces its cast time by 0.3 sec.
specTalents.name: Improved Haunt

specTalents.description:
Corruption is now permanent and deals 15% increased damage.

Duration reduced to 24 sec against players.
specTalents.name: Absolute Corruption

specTalents.description: Shadow Bolt and Drain Soul have a chance to trigger a Shadow Bolt Volley, dealing 3,669 Shadow damage to 5 enemies within 10 yards of your current target.
specTalents.name: Cunning Cruelty

specTalents.description: Your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction deal damage 40% faster.
specTalents.name: Creeping Death

specTalents.description:
Consume the life force of each target afflicted by your damaging periodic effects, dealing 104,574 Shadowflame damage over 2.3 sec.

Damage dealt by Dark Harvest heals you for 50% of damage done.
specTalents.name: Dark Harvest

specTalents.description: Mastery increased by 2%.
specTalents.name: Practiced Pestilence

specTalents.description:
Summons a Darkglare from the Twisting Nether that increases the damage of your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction by 20% while active.

The Darkglare will serve you for 20 sec, blasting its target for 14,791 Shadow damage, increased by 10% for every damage over time effect you have active on their current target.
specTalents.name: Summon Darkglare

specTalents.description: Increases the damage dealt by your spells and your demon by 3%.
specTalents.name: Summoner's Embrace

specTalents.description: Casting Unstable Affliction or Seed of Corruption reduces the cooldown of Dark Harvest by 1.5 sec.
specTalents.name: Cull the Weak

specTalents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction by 5%.
specTalents.name: Malediction

specTalents.description: Agony damage is increased by 10% and starts at 3 stacks.
specTalents.name: Sudden Onset

specTalents.description:
While Darkglare is active, your Drain Soul becomes Malefic Grasp. 

 Malefic Grasp
Binds the target in twilight, dealing 39,360 Shadow damage over 3.1 sec.

When Malefic Grasp deals damage, it causes all of your other periodic Affliction damage effects to instantly deal 30% of their normal periodic damage.
specTalents.name: Malefic Grasp

specTalents.description: Corruption damage is increased by 15%, and each time it deals damage any of your Curses active on the target are extended by 0.5 sec.
specTalents.name: Sacrolash's Dark Strike

specTalents.description: Increases critical strike damage dealt by Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction by 15%.
specTalents.name: Contagion

specTalents.description: Damage dealt by Drain Soul has a 20% chance to make your next Unstable Affliction or Seed of Corruption cost no Soul Shards and cast instantly.
specTalents.name: Shard Instability

specTalents.description: Increases damage dealt by Agony and Corruption by 10%.
specTalents.name: Niskaran Methods

specTalents.description: Increases damage dealt by Unstable Affliction and Seed of Corruption by 5%.
specTalents.name: Potent Soul Shards

specTalents.description: Reduces the cast time of Unstable Affliction by 0.60 sec and increases its damage by 20%.
specTalents.name: Xavius' Gambit

specTalents.description: Critical strikes from your Agony, Corruption, and Unstable Affliction have a chance to grant Nightfall.
specTalents.name: Ravenous Afflictions

specTalents.description: Casting Unstable Affliction on a target affected by your Unstable Affliction increases your Haste by 5% for 15 sec.
specTalents.name: Cascading Calamity

specTalents.description: Agony, Corruption, Unstable Affliction, Seed of Corruption, and Shadow Bolt deal up to 40% increased damage on targets below 35% health. Damage increase is higher against lower health targets.
specTalents.name: Death's Embrace

specTalents.description:
Damage dealt by Haunt has a chance to release the demonic soul haunting its target. When released, it unleashes a devastating attack before being banished back to Nathreza.

 Wrath of Nathreza
Calls down a meteor formed from the ruins of Nathreza that explodes upon impact, dealing 68,730 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
specTalents.name: Shadow of Nathreza

specTalents.description: Increases the initial damage of Haunt by 200% and Haunt increases damage dealt to its host by an additional 8%.
specTalents.name: Shadow of Nathreza

specTalents.description:
Haunt now calls upon a demonic soul from within the Twisting Nether to haunt your target.

The soul is unstable and ravenous, dealing 66,430 Shadow damage to its host and 3 enemies within 10 yards suffering from your Corruption over its duration.
specTalents.name: Shadow of Nathreza

Demonic Circle: Teleport: Increases your movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

Demonic Gateway: Can be cast instantly.

Drain Life: Gain an absorb shield equal to the amount of healing done for 30 sec. This shield cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Healthstone: Increases the healing of your Healthstone by 30% and increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
classTalents.name: Soulburn

heroTalents.description: Fire damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Fire spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
heroTalents.name: Xalan's Ferocity

heroTalents.description:
If the target is afflicted with your Wither, casting Unstable Affliction increase its stack count by 1.

Each time Wither gains a stack it has a chance to collapse, consuming a stack every 1 sec to deal 8,364 Shadowflame damage to its host until 1 stack remains.
heroTalents.name: Blackened Soul

heroTalents.description: Shadow damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Shadow spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
heroTalents.name: Xalan's Cruelty

heroTalents.description:
Increases the damage of Unstable Affliction by 8% and Seed of Corruption by 4%.

This effect is doubled while Malevolence is active.
heroTalents.name: Through the Felvine

heroTalents.description: While Unending Resolve is active, enemies within 30 yds are affected by Curse of Tongues and Curse of Weakness at 100% effectiveness.
heroTalents.name: Aura of Enfeeblement

heroTalents.description: Wither damage increased 20%. When Wither gains a stack from Blackened Soul, it has a chance to gain an additional stack.
heroTalents.name: Bleakheart Tactics

heroTalents.description: Dark Pact heals you for 6,217 every 1 sec while active.
heroTalents.name: Zevrim's Resilience

heroTalents.description: Periodic damage dealt by Wither has a chance to grant Malevolence for 8 sec.
heroTalents.name: Devil Fruit

heroTalents.description:
Agony damage increased by 30%.

Blackened Soul deals 2% increased damage per stack of Wither.
heroTalents.name: Mark of Xavius

heroTalents.description:
After Wither reaches 8 stacks or when its host reaches 20% health, Wither deals 8,364 Shadowflame damage to its host every 1 sec until 1 stack remains.

When Blackened Soul deals damage, you have a chance to gain Shard Instability.
heroTalents.name: Seeds of Their Demise

heroTalents.description:
Damaging critical strikes dealt by Wither deal 215% damage instead of the usual 200%.

Damaging critical strikes dealt by Blackened Soul deal 225% damage instead of the usual 200%.
heroTalents.name: Mark of Peroth'arn

heroTalents.description: Malevolence grants an additional 4% Haste and when cast increases the stack count of active Withers by an additional 2 stacks.
heroTalents.name: Alzzin's Iniquity

heroTalents.description:
Dark magic erupts from you and corrupts your soul for 20 sec, causing enemies suffering from your Wither to take 39,395 Shadowflame damage and increase its stack count by 6.

While corrupted your Haste is increased by 8% and spending Soul Shards on damaging spells grants 1 additional stack of Wither.
heroTalents.name: Malevolence

specTalents.description: Unleashes a devastating blast of chaos, dealing a critical strike for 27,109 Chaos damage. Damage is further increased by your critical strike chance.
specTalents.name: Chaos Bolt

specTalents.description:
Triggers an explosion on the target, dealing 11,308 Fire damage.

Generates 5 Soul Shard Fragments.
specTalents.name: Conflagrate

specTalents.description:
Calls down a rain of hellfire the target location, dealing 17,838 Fire damage over 6.3 sec to enemies in the area.

This spell is cast at a selected location.
specTalents.name: Rain of Fire

specTalents.description: Conflagrate reduces the cast time of your next Incinerate, Chaos Bolt, or Soul Fire by 30%. Maximum 2 charges.
specTalents.name: Backdraft

specTalents.description: Increases Mastery by 2%.
specTalents.name: Practiced Chaos

specTalents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Conflagrate by 2 sec.
specTalents.name: Explosive Potential

specTalents.description: Marks a target with Havoc for 15 sec, causing your single target spells to also strike the Havoc victim for 50% of the damage dealt.
specTalents.name: Havoc

specTalents.description: Increases the damage of Immolate by 25% and its duration by 3 sec.
specTalents.name: Scalding Flames

specTalents.description:
Blasts a target for 15,210 Shadowflame damage. Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.

Restores 1 Soul Shard and removes its cooldown if the target dies within 5 sec.
specTalents.name: Shadowburn

specTalents.description:
Increases your critical strike chance by 4%.

Physical attacks against you have a 40% chance to make your next Incinerate instant cast. This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.
specTalents.name: Backlash

specTalents.description: Chaos Bolt, Shadowburn, and Incinerate deal 6% increased damage to targets afflicted by Immolate.
specTalents.name: Ashen Remains

specTalents.description: Critical strikes dealt by Chaos Bolt, Conflagrate, or Incinerate have a 10% chance to make your next cast of Shadowburn within 30 sec cost no Soul Shards and usable on any target regardless of health.
specTalents.name: Fiendish Cruelty

specTalents.description: Increases Chaos Bolt damage by 5% and Chaos Bolt now has a 25% chance to make your next Incinerate instant.
specTalents.name: Chaotic Inferno

specTalents.description:
When your Immolate deals periodic damage to a target above 80% health, gain 2% Haste for 10 sec.

Stacks up to 3 times.
specTalents.name: Flashpoint

specTalents.description:
Summons an Infernal from the Twisting Nether, impacting for 1,903 Fire damage and stunning all enemies in the area for 2 sec.

The Infernal will serve you for 30 sec, dealing 1,785 damage to all nearby enemies every 1.6 sec and generating 1 Soul Shard Fragment every 1 sec.
specTalents.name: Summon Infernal

specTalents.description: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2% and reduces the cast time of your Incinerate spell by 20%.
specTalents.name: Emberstorm

specTalents.description: Your spells have a chance to grant you 15% Haste for 8 sec.
specTalents.name: Reverse Entropy

specTalents.description: Increases the damage dealt by your spells and your demon by 3%.
specTalents.name: Summoner's Embrace

specTalents.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your Destruction spells by 30%.
specTalents.name: Ruin

specTalents.description: Increases the damage of Chaos Bolt by 10% and reduces its cast time by 0.5 sec.
specTalents.name: Improved Chaos Bolt

specTalents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 6%.
specTalents.name: Devastation

specTalents.description:
Burns the enemy's soul, dealing 119,807 Fire damage and applying Immolate.

Generates 1 Soul Shard.

specTalents.description: Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, and Shadowburn always gain at least 70% of the maximum benefit from your Mastery: Chaotic Energies.
specTalents.name: Chaos Incarnate

specTalents.description: Conflagrate and Shadowburn have a 100% chance to critically strike and their damage is increased by your critical strike chance.
specTalents.name: Conflagration of Chaos

specTalents.description:
Casting Soul Fire summons an Overfiend.

Opening a Dimensional Rift has a chance to summon an Overfiend instead.

 Summon Overfiend
Generates 1 Soul Shard Fragment every 1 sec and casts Chaos Bolt at 80% effectiveness at its summoner's target. Lasts 8 sec.
specTalents.name: Avatar of Destruction

specTalents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Summon Infernal by 30.0 sec and increases your Mastery by 3%.
specTalents.name: Inferno

specTalents.description:
Casting Chaos Bolt, Shadowburn, or Rain of Fire evokes an echo of the Dark Titan's power at 50%, 50%, or 60% effectiveness respectively.

If no target is found, a random target suffering from your Immolate will be selected.
specTalents.name: Embers of Nihilam

specTalents.description: Memories of the Titans' destruction flash in your mind when you evoke the Dark Titan's power, increasing critical strike by 8% and haste by 8% for 6 sec.
specTalents.name: Embers of Nihilam

specTalents.description:
Casting Incinerate has a 10% chance to evoke an echo of the Dark Titan's power.

 Echo of Sargeras
Hurl an ember torn from Nihilam at the target, dealing 5,836 Shadowflame damage and an additional 5,058 Shadowflame damage to all enemies within 10 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

raids.description: The Dreamrift exists deep within the Rift of Aln, where the dreams of Aln'hara took form long ago. Dark manifestations have grown within the rift in Aln'hara's absence, devouring each other in an endless cycle. Even the brave haranir dare not delve too deep, for now something greater and more terrible lurks within the Dreamrift's depths.
raids.name: The Dreamrift
raids.title: The Dreamrift
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: From high above the Voidstorm, Xal'atath has gathered the Devouring Host beneath her dark banner. The towering Voidspire looms like a spear of darkness, a citadel guarded by an army of the void. The forces of the light - led by Alleria Windrunner and the Champions of Azeroth - must rally for one last desperate assault before all is lost.
raids.name: The Voidspire
raids.title: The Voidspire
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Darkness has eclipsed the Isle of Quel'Danas, clouding the skies above Silvermoon City. With Arator the Redeemer by their side, the Champions of Azeroth must march on the Sunwell before the light of the blood elves is lost forever.
raids.name: March on Quel'Danas
raids.title: March on Quel'Danas
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Deep in the fungal valleys of Harandar, the fungarian sporecallers have been growing a new threat for The Grudge Pit. Shaded by towering mushrooms, Sporefall is the perfect site to empower their new creation.
raids.name: Sporefall
raids.title: Sporefall
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Guided by the dark whispers of Malacrass, Zul'jan has freed the forgotten broods of Ula'tek from their prison. As the monster's power grows, Zul'jarra calls upon the Champions of Azeroth to descend into the Vaults of Atal'Utek to stop her brother before the weapon is unleashed upon Azeroth.
raids.name: The Venomous Abyss
raids.title: The Venomous Abyss
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Hidden beneath the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Kith'ix was bound in his subterranean lair. With the defeat of Ula'tek, the restraints keeping Kith'ix at bay have weakened, unleashing the monstrosity the Amani locked away so long ago.
raids.name: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.title: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.subtitle: Level 90

classTalents.description:
Healthstones you conjure for yourself are now Demonic Healthstones and can be used multiple times in combat. Demonic Healthstones cannot be traded.

 Demonic Healthstone
Instantly restores 30% health. 60 sec cooldown.
classTalents.name: Pact of Gluttony

classTalents.description:
Consumes a Soul Shard, unlocking the hidden power of your spells.

Demonic Circle: Teleport: Increases your movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

Demonic Gateway: Can be cast instantly.

Drain Life: Gain an absorb shield equal to the amount of healing done for 30 sec. This shield cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Healthstone: Increases the healing of your Healthstone by 30% and increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
classTalents.name: Soulburn

Unleashing your demonic soul bestows a fiendish entity unto the soul of its targets, dealing 8,323 Shadow damage over 8 sec.

If this effect is reapplied, any remaining damage will be added to the new Soul Anathema.
heroTalents.name: Soul Anathema

heroTalents.description: Your demonic soul deals 100% increased damage to targets affected by your Unstable Affliction.
heroTalents.name: Demoniac's Fervor

 Soul Swipe

heroTalents.description: Dark Pact now shields you for an additional 50% of the sacrificed health.
heroTalents.name: Friends In Dark Places

Deals reduced damage beyond 8 targets.

heroTalents.description: Fel Domination cooldown is reduced by 90 sec.
heroTalents.name: Eternal Servitude

Increases your Mastery by 2%.

heroTalents.name: Shared Vessel

Inflicts increasing agony on the target, causing up to 74,469 Shadow damage over 18 sec. Damage starts low and increases over the duration. Refreshing Agony maintains its current damage level.

Agony damage sometimes generates 1 Soul Shard.
specTalents.name: Agony

specTalents.description:
Afflicts the target with 33,302 Shadow damage over 8 sec. Multiple uses of this ability may overlap.

If dispelled, deals 323,860 damage to the dispeller and silences them for 4 sec. This damage is increased by 15% per stack on the target.

Generates 1 Soul Shard if the target dies while afflicted.
specTalents.name: Unstable Affliction

specTalents.description:
Embeds a demon seed in the enemy target that will explode after 9.4 sec, dealing 10,657 Shadow damage to all enemies within 10 yards and applying Corruption to them. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

The seed will detonate early if the target is hit by other detonations, or takes 1,251 damage from your spells.
specTalents.name: Seed of Corruption

specTalents.description:
Corruption damage has a chance to cause your next Drain Soul or Malefic Grasp to deal 75% increased damage. 

Drain Soul and Malefic Grasp channel 50% faster while affected.
specTalents.name: Nightfall

specTalents.description:
A ghostly soul haunts a single target, dealing 60,700 Shadow damage and increasing your damage dealt to the target by 20% for 18 sec.

While active, Haunt deals 66,430 Shadow damage to its host and 3 enemies within 10 yards suffering from your Corruption or Wither. If the target dies, Haunt's cooldown is reset.
specTalents.name: Haunt

specTalents.description: Increases Agony damage by 10% and Agony now hits another nearby enemy within 15 yds of the target.
specTalents.name: Shared Agony

Damage is increased by 100% against enemies below 20% health.

Generates 1 Soul Shard if the target dies during this effect.

Duration reduced to 24 sec against players.

Power Siphon and Implosion summon 1 Imp Gang Boss for every 2 Wild Imps sacrificed. Wild Imps summoned this way gain Unstable Soul.

 Unstable Soul
Increases damage done by 50% and Fel Firebolt now jumps to 4 additional targets.
specTalents.name: To Hell and Back

specTalents.description: Increases the duration of your Summon Vilefiend, Grimoire: Imp Lord, and Grimoire: Fel Ravager by 3 sec.
specTalents.name: Stabilized Portals

specTalents.description:
Your Summon Vilefiend becomes Summon Gloomhound and learns the following ability:

 Gloom Slash
Tooth and claw are drenched in malignant shadow magic, causing the Gloomhound's melee attacks to deal an additional 960 Shadow damage.
specTalents.name: Mark of Shatug

specTalents.description:
While Dominion of Argus is active, Hand of Gul'dan refunds 1 Soul Shard.

Demons summoned by Dominion of Argus last an additional 4 sec.
specTalents.name: Dominion of Argus

specTalents.description: Increases the duration of Dominion of Argus by 10 sec and increases damage dealt by Hand of Gul'dan by 20%.
specTalents.name: Dominion of Argus

specTalents.description: Summoning your Demonic Tyrant leaves open a portal to Argus for 15 sec, causing every 2 casts of Hand of Gul'dan to summon a subjugated demon that serves you for 10 sec.
specTalents.name: Dominion of Argus

classTalents.description: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus, Succubus, Felhunter, or Felguard Summon spell is free and has its casting time reduced by 90%.
classTalents.name: Fel Domination

classTalents.description:
Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.2% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 10% of maximum health.

Increases your armor by 90%.
classTalents.name: Demon Skin

classTalents.description:
When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 10% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.

Reduces damage taken by 3.0%.
classTalents.name: Fel Armor

classTalents.description: Stamina increased by 10%.
classTalents.name: Demonic Embrace

classTalents.description: Increases the amount of damage required to break your fear effects by 60%.
classTalents.name: Nightmare

classTalents.description: Increases you and your pets' maximum health by 5%.
classTalents.name: Demonic Fortitude

classTalents.description:
Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
classTalents.name: Curse of Exhaustion

classTalents.description: Horrifies an enemy target into fleeing, incapacitating for 3 sec and healing you for 25% of maximum health.
classTalents.name: Mortal Coil

classTalents.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.
classTalents.name: Pact of the Annihilan

classTalents.description:
Summons a Demonic Circle for 15 min. Cast Demonic Circle: Teleport to teleport to its location and remove all movement slowing effects.

You also learn:

 Demonic Circle: Teleport
Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and removes all movement slowing effects.
classTalents.name: Demonic Circle

classTalents.description: Increases your haste by 2%.
classTalents.name: Pact of the Satyr

classTalents.description: Increases the range of Mortal Coil by 10 yds and Mortal Coil now heals for an additional 5% of maximum health.
classTalents.name: Improved Mortal Coil

classTalents.description: Sacrifices 5% of your current health to shield you for 800% of the sacrificed health plus an additional 6,255 for 20 sec. Usable while suffering from control impairing effects.
classTalents.name: Dark Pact

classTalents.description: Casting Curse of Exhaustion, Curse of Tongues, or Curse of Weakness now curses all enemies within 10 yds of the target.
classTalents.name: Foul Mouth

classTalents.description: Healthstones heal you for an additional 5% additional health.
classTalents.name: Empowered Healthstone

classTalents.description: Using Demonic Circle: Teleport or your Demonic Gateway reduces all damage you take by 4% for 10 sec.
classTalents.name: Abyss Walker

classTalents.description: Soul Leech may now absorb an additional 5% of your maximum health.
classTalents.name: Fortified Soul

classTalents.description:
Your primary pets gain a bonus effect.

Imp: Successful Singe Magic casts grant the target 4% damage reduction for 5 sec.

Voidwalker: Reduces the cooldown of Shadow Bulwark by 30 sec.

Felhunter: Reduces the cooldown of Devour Magic by 5 sec.

Sayaad: Reduces the cooldown of Seduction by 10 sec and causes the target to walk faster towards the demon.
classTalents.name: Teachings of the Black Harvest

classTalents.description: Dark Pact sacrifices only 5% of your current health for the same shield value.
classTalents.name: Ichor of Devils

classTalents.description: Increases your Intellect by 3%.
classTalents.name: Pact of the Eredar

classTalents.description: Reduces the chance you will be critically struck by 2%. All damage your primary demon takes is reduced by 8%.
classTalents.name: Demonic Resilience

classTalents.description: Unending Resolve reduces damage taken by an additional 15%.
classTalents.name: Strength of Will

classTalents.description: Creates a demonic gateway between two locations. Activating the gateway transports the user to the other gateway. Each player can use a Demonic Gateway only once per 90 sec.
classTalents.name: Demonic Gateway

classTalents.description: Let loose a terrifying howl, causing 10 enemies within 10 yds to flee in fear, disorienting them for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
classTalents.name: Howl of Terror

classTalents.description:
20% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. 

While Grimoire of Sacrifice is active, your Stamina is increased by 12%.
classTalents.name: Soul Link

classTalents.description: Reduces the cast time of Demonic Gateway by 0.5 sec and you can now use Demonic Gateways twice before triggering a cooldown.
classTalents.name: Frequent Traveler

classTalents.description: Soul Leech also heals you for 15% and your pet for 100% of the absorption it grants.
classTalents.name: Fel Synergy

classTalents.description:
Reduces the cooldown of Shadowfury by 15 sec and increases its radius by 2 yds.

Reduces the cooldown of Howl of Terror by 5 sec and it now fears 5 additional enemies.
classTalents.name: Oppressive Darkness

classTalents.description:
Healthstones you conjure for yourself are now Demonic Healthstones and can be used multiple times in combat. Demonic Healthstones cannot be traded.

 Demonic Healthstone
Instantly restores 30% health. 60 sec cooldown.
classTalents.name: Pact of Gluttony

classTalents.description:
Consumes a Soul Shard, unlocking the hidden power of your spells.

Demonic Circle: Teleport: Increases your movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

Demonic Gateway: Can be cast instantly.

Drain Life: Gain an absorb shield equal to the amount of healing done for 30 sec. This shield cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Healthstone: Increases the healing of your Healthstone by 30% and increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
classTalents.name: Soulburn

heroTalents.description: Enemies damaged by your Overlord have their souls cloven, increasing damage taken by you and your pets by 5% for 15 sec.
heroTalents.name: Cloven Souls

heroTalents.description:
Demonic Art increases the damage of your next Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, or Shadowburn by 20% and reduces its cast time by 50%.

Casting Chaos Bolt reduces the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.
heroTalents.name: Touch of Rancora

heroTalents.description:
Mother of Chaos empowers your next Incinerate to become Infernal Bolt.

 Infernal Bolt
Hurl a bolt enveloped in the infernal flames of the abyss, dealing 71,470 Fire damage to your enemy target and generating 3 Soul Shards.
heroTalents.name: Secrets of the Coven

heroTalents.description:
You summon a Diabolic Oculus, up to 3, each time the duration of Diabolic Ritual is reduced by one of your spells.

Diabolic Oculi explode when consuming Demonic Art, dealing 7,303 Fire damage to all enemies within 10 yds of the target. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
heroTalents.name: Diabolic Oculi

heroTalents.description: Howl of Terror cooldown is reduced by 10 sec and range is increased by 5 yds.
heroTalents.name: Annihilan's Bellow

heroTalents.description: Spending Soul Shards on damaging spells while your Infernal is active decreases the duration of Diabolic Ritual by 1 additional sec.
heroTalents.name: Infernal Machine

heroTalents.description: Unending Resolve heals you for 30% of your maximum health over 10 sec.
heroTalents.name: Infernal Vitality

heroTalents.description:
Your Diabolic Oculi now cast Diabolic Gaze at your primary demon's target every 1 sec while active.

 Diabolic Gaze
Fire a beam of destructive chaos magic at the target, dealing 2,417 Chaos damage.

Damage is increased by 100% per Demonic Oculus active.
heroTalents.name: Looks That Kill

heroTalents.description: Fire damage increased by 4% and damage dealt by your demons is increased by 4%.
heroTalents.name: Flames of Xoroth

heroTalents.description: Summon Infernal becomes empowered, dealing 40% increased damage. When your Summon Infernal ends, it fragments into two smaller Infernals at 50% effectiveness that lasts 10 sec.
heroTalents.name: Abyssal Dominion

heroTalents.description: Enemies marked by your Havoc take 7% increased damage from your single target spells.
heroTalents.name: Gloom of Nathreza

heroTalents.description: Your Diabolic Oculi observe the battlefield and collect information that is imparted to you upon being exploded, each Diabolic Oculi increasing your Intellect by 2% for 10 sec.
heroTalents.name: Mind's Eyes

heroTalents.description:
Summoning a Pit Lord causes your next Chaos Bolt to become Ruination.

 Ruination
Call down a demon-infested meteor from the depths of the Twisting Nether, dealing 79,004 Chaos damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summoning 3 Wild Imps.

Damage is reduced beyond 8 targets.
heroTalents.name: Ruination

specTalents.description:
Calls down a demonic meteor full of Wild Imps which burst forth to attack the target.

Deals up to 4,760 Shadowflame damage on impact to all enemies within 8 yds of the target and summons 3 Wild Imps.
specTalents.name: Hand of Gul'dan

specTalents.description:
Grants access to the following abilities:

 Demonbolt
Send the fiery soul of a fallen demon at the enemy, causing 24,901 Shadowflame damage.

 Demonic Core
When your Wild Imps fade or are imploded, you have a 10% chance to absorb their life essence, granting you a stack of Demonic Core. 

When your summoned Dreadstalkers fade away, you have a 100% chance to absorb their life essence, granting you a stack of Demonic Core.

Demonic Core reduces the cast time of Demonbolt by 100%. Maximum 4 stacks.
specTalents.name: Demoniac

specTalents.description: Summons 2 ferocious Dreadstalkers to attack the target for 12 sec.
specTalents.name: Call Dreadstalkers

specTalents.description: Increases your Intellect by 2%.
specTalents.name: Fel Intellect

specTalents.description: Increases your Mastery by 2%.
specTalents.name: Practiced Rituals

specTalents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Wild Imp's Fel Firebolt by 15%.
specTalents.name: Imp-erator

specTalents.description: Instantly sacrifice up to 2 Wild Imps, generating 2 charges of Demonic Core that cause Demonbolt to deal 50% additional damage.
specTalents.name: Power Siphon

specTalents.description: Summons a Felguard under your command as a powerful melee combatant.
specTalents.name: Summon Felguard

specTalents.description: When your Wild Imps cast Fel Firebolt, they have 10% chance to instantly cast another Fel Firebolt at 200% effectiveness.
specTalents.name: Infernal Rapidity

specTalents.description: Reduces the cast time of Shadow Bolt by 20% and increases its damage by 30%.
specTalents.name: Rune of Shadows

specTalents.description: Your Dreadstalkers' attacks have a 20% chance to trigger an additional Dreadbite.
specTalents.name: Carnivorous Stalkers

specTalents.description: Hand of Gul'dan now empowers 1 of the Wild Imps it summons, increasing its damage dealt by 100%.

specTalents.name: Inner Demons

specTalents.description:

specTalents.name: Summon Demonic Tyrant

specTalents.description: The fangs of your Dreadstalkers are coated in corrosive bile, causing Dreadbite to deal additional damage equal to 50% of damage dealt as Plague damage.
specTalents.name: Blighted Maw

specTalents.description: Increases Demonbolt damage by 10% and consuming a Demonic Core has a chance to summon a Wild Imp.
specTalents.name: Spiteful Reconstitution

specTalents.description: Your Demonic Tyrant also empowers you while active, increasing your haste by 8%.
specTalents.name: Tyrant's Oblation

specTalents.description:
Your Demonic Tyrant is equipped with armor forged within Antorus, increasing their armor by 10%. While summoned, your Demonic Tyrant now assaults enemies with powerful melee attacks.

 Burning Cleave
Cleaves the area around the caster, inflicting 2,927 Shadowflame damage to targets within 8 yds. Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.

specTalents.description: Increases the attack speed of your Dreadstalkers by 10% and their critical strike chance by 15%.
specTalents.name: Flametouched

specTalents.description: Hand of Gul'dan has a 15% chance to generate a charge of Demonic Core.
specTalents.name: Demonic Knowledge

specTalents.description: Shadow Bolt and Demonbolt deal 2% additional damage per demon you have summoned.
specTalents.name: Sacrificed Souls

specTalents.description: Your Demonic Tyrant lasts an additional 5 sec and extends the duration of your Dreadstalkers by 15 sec when summoned.
specTalents.name: Reign of Tyranny

specTalents.description: Increases Mastery by 3% and reduces the cast time of your Summon Demonic Tyrant and Summon Felguard by 0.5 sec.
specTalents.name: Master Summoner

specTalents.description: Call Dreadstalkers costs 2 less Soul Shards and its cast time is reduced by 100%.
specTalents.name: Demonic Calling

specTalents.description:
When Demonbolt consumes a Demonic Core it inflicts impending doom upon the target, dealing 12,549 Shadow damage to enemies within 10 yds of its target after 20 sec or when removed. Damage is reduced beyond 8 targets.

Hand of Gul'dan reduces the duration of Doom by 3 sec.
specTalents.name: Doom

specTalents.description: Your demons deal 1.0% increased damage for each demon you control.
specTalents.name: Hellbent Commander

Transforms into Singe Magic while on cooldown.
specTalents.name: Grimoire: Imp Lord

specTalents.description: Call Dreadstalkers also summons a Vilefiend that assists you in combat for 15 sec.
specTalents.name: Summon Vilefiend

specTalents.description:

specTalents.name: Summon Doomguard

Power Siphon and Implosion summon 1 Imp Gang Boss for every 2 Wild Imps sacrificed. Wild Imps summoned this way gain Unstable Soul.

 Unstable Soul
Increases damage done by 50% and Fel Firebolt now jumps to 4 additional targets.
specTalents.name: To Hell and Back

specTalents.description:
Your Summon Vilefiend becomes Summon Gloomhound and learns the following ability:

 Gloom Slash
Tooth and claw are drenched in malignant shadow magic, causing the Gloomhound's melee attacks to deal an additional 960 Shadow damage.
specTalents.name: Mark of Shatug

specTalents.description:
While Dominion of Argus is active, Hand of Gul'dan refunds 1 Soul Shard.

Demons summoned by Dominion of Argus last an additional 4 sec.
specTalents.name: Dominion of Argus

specTalents.description: Increases the duration of Dominion of Argus by 10 sec and increases damage dealt by Hand of Gul'dan by 20%.
specTalents.name: Dominion of Argus

specTalents.description: Summoning your Demonic Tyrant leaves open a portal to Argus for 15 sec, causing every 2 casts of Hand of Gul'dan to summon a subjugated demon that serves you for 10 sec.
specTalents.name: Dominion of Argus

specs.name: Demonology

pvpTalents.description:
Taking direct Physical damage reduces the cooldown of Demonic Circle by 3 sec.

Cannot occur more than once every 5 sec.
pvpTalents.name: Impish Instincts

pvpTalents.description: Surrounds the caster with a shield that lasts 3 sec, reflecting all harmful spells cast on you.
pvpTalents.name: Nether Ward

pvpTalents.description:
Fracture the soul of up to 3 target players within 20 yds into the shadows, reducing their damage done by 25% and healing received by 25% for 8 sec. Souls are fractured up to 20 yds from the player's location.

Players can retrieve their souls to remove this effect.
pvpTalents.name: Soul Rip

specs.description:
A master of chaos who calls down fire to burn and demolish enemies.

Preferred Weapon: Staff, Wand, Dagger, Sword

classTalents.description: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus, Succubus, Felhunter, or Felguard Summon spell is free and has its casting time reduced by 90%.
classTalents.name: Fel Domination

classTalents.description:
Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.2% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 10% of maximum health.

Increases your armor by 90%.
classTalents.name: Demon Skin

classTalents.description:
When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 10% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.

Reduces damage taken by 3.0%.
classTalents.name: Fel Armor

classTalents.description: Stamina increased by 10%.
classTalents.name: Demonic Embrace

classTalents.description: Increases the amount of damage required to break your fear effects by 60%.
classTalents.name: Nightmare

classTalents.description: Increases you and your pets' maximum health by 5%.
classTalents.name: Demonic Fortitude

classTalents.description:
Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
classTalents.name: Curse of Exhaustion

classTalents.description: Healing done by Drain Life also heals your primary demon at 400% effectiveness.
classTalents.name: Infernal Beneficiary

classTalents.description: Horrifies an enemy target into fleeing, incapacitating for 3 sec and healing you for 25% of maximum health.
classTalents.name: Mortal Coil

classTalents.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.
classTalents.name: Pact of the Annihilan

classTalents.description:
Summons a Demonic Circle for 15 min. Cast Demonic Circle: Teleport to teleport to its location and remove all movement slowing effects.

You also learn:

 Demonic Circle: Teleport
Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and removes all movement slowing effects.
classTalents.name: Demonic Circle

classTalents.description: Increases your haste by 2%.
classTalents.name: Pact of the Satyr

classTalents.description: Increases the range of Mortal Coil by 10 yds and Mortal Coil now heals for an additional 5% of maximum health.
classTalents.name: Improved Mortal Coil

classTalents.description: Sacrifices 5% of your current health to shield you for 800% of the sacrificed health plus an additional 6,255 for 20 sec. Usable while suffering from control impairing effects.
classTalents.name: Dark Pact

classTalents.description: Casting Curse of Exhaustion, Curse of Tongues, or Curse of Weakness now curses all enemies within 10 yds of the target.
classTalents.name: Foul Mouth

classTalents.description: Healthstones heal you for an additional 5% additional health.
classTalents.name: Empowered Healthstone

classTalents.description: Using Demonic Circle: Teleport or your Demonic Gateway reduces all damage you take by 4% for 10 sec.
classTalents.name: Abyss Walker

classTalents.description: Soul Leech may now absorb an additional 5% of your maximum health.
classTalents.name: Fortified Soul

classTalents.description:
Your primary pets gain a bonus effect.

Imp: Successful Singe Magic casts grant the target 4% damage reduction for 5 sec.

Voidwalker: Reduces the cooldown of Shadow Bulwark by 30 sec.

Felhunter: Reduces the cooldown of Devour Magic by 5 sec.

Sayaad: Reduces the cooldown of Seduction by 10 sec and causes the target to walk faster towards the demon.
classTalents.name: Teachings of the Black Harvest

classTalents.description: Drain Life now channels 100% faster and restores health 100% faster.
classTalents.name: Gorefiend's Avarice

classTalents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Dark Pact by 15 sec.
classTalents.name: Frequent Donor

classTalents.description: Increases your Intellect by 3%.
classTalents.name: Pact of the Eredar

classTalents.description: Reduces the chance you will be critically struck by 2%. All damage your primary demon takes is reduced by 8%.
classTalents.name: Demonic Resilience

classTalents.description: Unending Resolve reduces damage taken by an additional 15%.
classTalents.name: Strength of Will

classTalents.description: Creates a demonic gateway between two locations. Activating the gateway transports the user to the other gateway. Each player can use a Demonic Gateway only once per 90 sec.
classTalents.name: Demonic Gateway

classTalents.description: Let loose a terrifying howl, causing 10 enemies within 10 yds to flee in fear, disorienting them for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
classTalents.name: Howl of Terror

classTalents.description:
20% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. 

While Grimoire of Sacrifice is active, your Stamina is increased by 12%.
classTalents.name: Soul Link

classTalents.description: Reduces the cast time of Demonic Gateway by 0.5 sec and you can now use Demonic Gateways twice before triggering a cooldown.
classTalents.name: Frequent Traveler

classTalents.description:
Reduces the cooldown of Shadowfury by 15 sec and increases its radius by 2 yds.

Reduces the cooldown of Howl of Terror by 5 sec and it now fears 5 additional enemies.
classTalents.name: Oppressive Darkness

classTalents.description:
Healthstones you conjure for yourself are now Demonic Healthstones and can be used multiple times in combat. Demonic Healthstones cannot be traded.

 Demonic Healthstone
Instantly restores 30% health. 60 sec cooldown.
classTalents.name: Pact of Gluttony

classTalents.description:
Consumes a Soul Shard, unlocking the hidden power of your spells.

Demonic Circle: Teleport: Increases your movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

Demonic Gateway: Can be cast instantly.

Drain Life: Gain an absorb shield equal to the amount of healing done for 30 sec. This shield cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Healthstone: Increases the healing of your Healthstone by 30% and increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
classTalents.name: Soulburn

heroTalents.description: Fire damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Fire spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
heroTalents.name: Xalan's Ferocity

heroTalents.description:
If the target is afflicted with your Wither, casting Unstable Affliction increase its stack count by 1.

Each time Wither gains a stack it has a chance to collapse, consuming a stack every 1 sec to deal 8,364 Shadowflame damage to its host until 1 stack remains.
heroTalents.name: Blackened Soul

heroTalents.description: Shadow damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Shadow spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
heroTalents.name: Xalan's Cruelty

heroTalents.description:
Increases the damage of Unstable Affliction by 8% and Seed of Corruption by 4%.

This effect is doubled while Malevolence is active.
heroTalents.name: Through the Felvine

heroTalents.description: While Unending Resolve is active, enemies within 30 yds are affected by Curse of Tongues and Curse of Weakness at 100% effectiveness.
heroTalents.name: Aura of Enfeeblement

heroTalents.description: Wither damage increased 20%. When Wither gains a stack from Blackened Soul, it has a chance to gain an additional stack.
heroTalents.name: Bleakheart Tactics

heroTalents.description: Dark Pact heals you for 6,217 every 1 sec while active.
heroTalents.name: Zevrim's Resilience

heroTalents.description: Periodic damage dealt by Wither has a chance to grant Malevolence for 8 sec.
heroTalents.name: Devil Fruit

heroTalents.description:
Agony damage increased by 30%.

Blackened Soul deals 2% increased damage per stack of Wither.
heroTalents.name: Mark of Xavius

heroTalents.description:
After Wither reaches 8 stacks or when its host reaches 20% health, Wither deals 8,364 Shadowflame damage to its host every 1 sec until 1 stack remains.

When Blackened Soul deals damage, you have a chance to gain Shard Instability.
heroTalents.name: Seeds of Their Demise

heroTalents.description:
Damaging critical strikes dealt by Wither deal 215% damage instead of the usual 200%.

Damaging critical strikes dealt by Blackened Soul deal 225% damage instead of the usual 200%.
heroTalents.name: Mark of Peroth'arn

heroTalents.description: Malevolence grants an additional 4% Haste and when cast increases the stack count of active Withers by an additional 2 stacks.
heroTalents.name: Alzzin's Iniquity

heroTalents.description:
Dark magic erupts from you and corrupts your soul for 20 sec, causing enemies suffering from your Wither to take 39,395 Shadowflame damage and increase its stack count by 6.

While corrupted your Haste is increased by 8% and spending Soul Shards on damaging spells grants 1 additional stack of Wither.
heroTalents.name: Malevolence

specTalents.description: Unleashes a devastating blast of chaos, dealing a critical strike for 27,109 Chaos damage. Damage is further increased by your critical strike chance.
specTalents.name: Chaos Bolt

specTalents.description:
Triggers an explosion on the target, dealing 11,308 Fire damage.

Generates 5 Soul Shard Fragments.
specTalents.name: Conflagrate

specTalents.description:
Calls down a rain of hellfire the target location, dealing 17,838 Fire damage over 6.3 sec to enemies in the area.

This spell is cast at a selected location.
specTalents.name: Rain of Fire

specTalents.description: Conflagrate reduces the cast time of your next Incinerate, Chaos Bolt, or Soul Fire by 30%. Maximum 2 charges.
specTalents.name: Backdraft

specTalents.description: Increases Mastery by 2%.
specTalents.name: Practiced Chaos

specTalents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Conflagrate by 2 sec.
specTalents.name: Explosive Potential

specTalents.description: Marks a target with Havoc for 15 sec, causing your single target spells to also strike the Havoc victim for 50% of the damage dealt.
specTalents.name: Havoc

specTalents.description: Increases the damage of Immolate by 25% and its duration by 3 sec.
specTalents.name: Scalding Flames

specTalents.description:
Blasts a target for 15,210 Shadowflame damage. Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.

Restores 1 Soul Shard and removes its cooldown if the target dies within 5 sec.
specTalents.name: Shadowburn

specTalents.description:
Increases your critical strike chance by 4%.

Physical attacks against you have a 40% chance to make your next Incinerate instant cast. This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.
specTalents.name: Backlash

specTalents.description: Chaos Bolt, Shadowburn, and Incinerate deal 6% increased damage to targets afflicted by Immolate.
specTalents.name: Ashen Remains

specTalents.description: Critical strikes dealt by Chaos Bolt, Conflagrate, or Incinerate have a 10% chance to make your next cast of Shadowburn within 30 sec cost no Soul Shards and usable on any target regardless of health.
specTalents.name: Fiendish Cruelty

specTalents.description: Increases Chaos Bolt damage by 5% and Chaos Bolt now has a 25% chance to make your next Incinerate instant.
specTalents.name: Chaotic Inferno

specTalents.description:
When your Immolate deals periodic damage to a target above 80% health, gain 2% Haste for 10 sec.

Stacks up to 3 times.
specTalents.name: Flashpoint

specTalents.description:
Summons an Infernal from the Twisting Nether, impacting for 1,903 Fire damage and stunning all enemies in the area for 2 sec.

The Infernal will serve you for 30 sec, dealing 1,785 damage to all nearby enemies every 1.6 sec and generating 1 Soul Shard Fragment every 1 sec.
specTalents.name: Summon Infernal

specTalents.description: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2% and reduces the cast time of your Incinerate spell by 20%.
specTalents.name: Emberstorm

specTalents.description: Your spells have a chance to grant you 15% Haste for 8 sec.
specTalents.name: Reverse Entropy

specTalents.description: Increases the damage dealt by your spells and your demon by 3%.
specTalents.name: Summoner's Embrace

specTalents.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your Destruction spells by 30%.
specTalents.name: Ruin

specTalents.description: Increases the damage of Chaos Bolt by 10% and reduces its cast time by 0.5 sec.
specTalents.name: Improved Chaos Bolt

specTalents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 6%.
specTalents.name: Devastation

specTalents.description:
Burns the enemy's soul, dealing 119,807 Fire damage and applying Immolate.

Generates 1 Soul Shard.
specTalents.name: Soul Fire

specTalents.description: Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, and Shadowburn always gain at least 70% of the maximum benefit from your Mastery: Chaotic Energies.
specTalents.name: Chaos Incarnate

specTalents.description: Conflagrate and Shadowburn have a 100% chance to critically strike and their damage is increased by your critical strike chance.
specTalents.name: Conflagration of Chaos

specTalents.description:
Casting Soul Fire summons an Overfiend.

Opening a Dimensional Rift has a chance to summon an Overfiend instead.

 Summon Overfiend
Generates 1 Soul Shard Fragment every 1 sec and casts Chaos Bolt at 80% effectiveness at its summoner's target. Lasts 8 sec.
specTalents.name: Avatar of Destruction

specTalents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Summon Infernal by 30.0 sec and increases your Mastery by 3%.
specTalents.name: Inferno

specTalents.description:
Casting Chaos Bolt, Shadowburn, or Rain of Fire evokes an echo of the Dark Titan's power at 50%, 50%, or 60% effectiveness respectively.

If no target is found, a random target suffering from your Immolate will be selected.
specTalents.name: Embers of Nihilam

specTalents.description: Memories of the Titans' destruction flash in your mind when you evoke the Dark Titan's power, increasing critical strike by 8% and haste by 8% for 6 sec.
specTalents.name: Embers of Nihilam

specTalents.description:
Casting Incinerate has a 10% chance to evoke an echo of the Dark Titan's power.

 Echo of Sargeras
Hurl an ember torn from Nihilam at the target, dealing 5,836 Shadowflame damage and an additional 5,058 Shadowflame damage to all enemies within 10 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
specTalents.name: Embers of Nihilam

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
