Hurl an ember torn from Nihilam at the target, dealing 5,836 Shadowflame damage and an additional 5,058 Shadowflame damage to all enemies within 10 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
specTalents.name: Embers of Nihilam

classTalents.description: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Incubus, Succubus, Felhunter, or Felguard Summon spell is free and has its casting time reduced by 90%.
classTalents.name: Fel Domination

classTalents.description:
Your Soul Leech absorption now passively recharges at a rate of 0.2% of maximum health every 1 sec, and may now absorb an additional 10% of maximum health.

Increases your armor by 90%.
classTalents.name: Demon Skin

classTalents.description:
When Soul Leech absorbs damage, 10% of damage taken is absorbed and spread out over 5 sec.

Reduces damage taken by 3.0%.
classTalents.name: Fel Armor

classTalents.description: Stamina increased by 10%.
classTalents.name: Demonic Embrace

classTalents.description: Increases the amount of damage required to break your fear effects by 60%.
classTalents.name: Nightmare

classTalents.description: Increases you and your pets' maximum health by 5%.
classTalents.name: Demonic Fortitude

classTalents.description:
Reduces the target's movement speed by 50% for 12 sec.

Curses: A warlock can only have one Curse active per target.
classTalents.name: Curse of Exhaustion

classTalents.description: Healing done by Drain Life also heals your primary demon at 400% effectiveness.
classTalents.name: Infernal Beneficiary

classTalents.description: Horrifies an enemy target into fleeing, incapacitating for 3 sec and healing you for 25% of maximum health.
classTalents.name: Mortal Coil

classTalents.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 2%.
classTalents.name: Pact of the Annihilan

classTalents.description:
Summons a Demonic Circle for 15 min. Cast Demonic Circle: Teleport to teleport to its location and remove all movement slowing effects.

You also learn:

 Demonic Circle: Teleport
Teleports you to your Demonic Circle and removes all movement slowing effects.
classTalents.name: Demonic Circle

classTalents.description: Increases your haste by 2%.
classTalents.name: Pact of the Satyr

classTalents.description: Increases the range of Mortal Coil by 10 yds and Mortal Coil now heals for an additional 5% of maximum health.
classTalents.name: Improved Mortal Coil

classTalents.description: Sacrifices 5% of your current health to shield you for 800% of the sacrificed health plus an additional 6,255 for 20 sec. Usable while suffering from control impairing effects.
classTalents.name: Dark Pact

classTalents.description: Casting Curse of Exhaustion, Curse of Tongues, or Curse of Weakness now curses all enemies within 10 yds of the target.
classTalents.name: Foul Mouth

classTalents.description: Healthstones heal you for an additional 5% additional health.
classTalents.name: Empowered Healthstone

classTalents.description: Using Demonic Circle: Teleport or your Demonic Gateway reduces all damage you take by 4% for 10 sec.
classTalents.name: Abyss Walker

classTalents.description: Soul Leech may now absorb an additional 5% of your maximum health.
classTalents.name: Fortified Soul

classTalents.description:
Your primary pets gain a bonus effect.

Imp: Successful Singe Magic casts grant the target 4% damage reduction for 5 sec.

Voidwalker: Reduces the cooldown of Shadow Bulwark by 30 sec.

Felhunter: Reduces the cooldown of Devour Magic by 5 sec.

Sayaad: Reduces the cooldown of Seduction by 10 sec and causes the target to walk faster towards the demon.
classTalents.name: Teachings of the Black Harvest

classTalents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Dark Pact by 15 sec.
classTalents.name: Frequent Donor

classTalents.description: Increases your Intellect by 3%.
classTalents.name: Pact of the Eredar

classTalents.description: Reduces the chance you will be critically struck by 2%. All damage your primary demon takes is reduced by 8%.
classTalents.name: Demonic Resilience

classTalents.description: Unending Resolve reduces damage taken by an additional 15%.
classTalents.name: Strength of Will

classTalents.description: Creates a demonic gateway between two locations. Activating the gateway transports the user to the other gateway. Each player can use a Demonic Gateway only once per 90 sec.
classTalents.name: Demonic Gateway

classTalents.description: Let loose a terrifying howl, causing 10 enemies within 10 yds to flee in fear, disorienting them for 20 sec. Damage may cancel the effect.
classTalents.name: Howl of Terror

classTalents.description:
20% of all damage you take is taken by your demon pet instead. 

While Grimoire of Sacrifice is active, your Stamina is increased by 12%.
classTalents.name: Soul Link

classTalents.description: Reduces the cast time of Demonic Gateway by 0.5 sec and you can now use Demonic Gateways twice before triggering a cooldown.
classTalents.name: Frequent Traveler

classTalents.description: Soul Leech also heals you for 8% and your pet for 50% of the absorption it grants.
classTalents.name: Fel Synergy

classTalents.description:
Reduces the cooldown of Shadowfury by 15 sec and increases its radius by 2 yds.

Reduces the cooldown of Howl of Terror by 5 sec and it now fears 5 additional enemies.
classTalents.name: Oppressive Darkness

classTalents.description:
Healthstones you conjure for yourself are now Demonic Healthstones and can be used multiple times in combat. Demonic Healthstones cannot be traded.

 Demonic Healthstone
Instantly restores 30% health. 60 sec cooldown.
classTalents.name: Pact of Gluttony

classTalents.description:
Consumes a Soul Shard, unlocking the hidden power of your spells.

Demonic Circle: Teleport: Increases your movement speed by 50% and makes you immune to snares and roots for 6 sec.

Demonic Gateway: Can be cast instantly.

Drain Life: Gain an absorb shield equal to the amount of healing done for 30 sec. This shield cannot exceed 30% of your maximum health.

Healthstone: Increases the healing of your Healthstone by 30% and increases your maximum health by 20% for 12 sec.
classTalents.name: Soulburn

heroTalents.description: Fire damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Fire spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
heroTalents.name: Xalan's Ferocity

heroTalents.description:
If the target is afflicted with your Wither, casting Unstable Affliction increase its stack count by 1.

Each time Wither gains a stack it has a chance to collapse, consuming a stack every 1 sec to deal 8,364 Shadowflame damage to its host until 1 stack remains.
heroTalents.name: Blackened Soul

heroTalents.description: Shadow damage dealt by your spells and abilities is increased by 6% and your Shadow spells gain 10% more critical strike chance from all sources.
heroTalents.name: Xalan's Cruelty

heroTalents.description:
Increases the damage of Unstable Affliction by 8% and Seed of Corruption by 4%.

This effect is doubled while Malevolence is active.
heroTalents.name: Through the Felvine

heroTalents.description: While Unending Resolve is active, enemies within 30 yds are affected by Curse of Tongues and Curse of Weakness at 100% effectiveness.
heroTalents.name: Aura of Enfeeblement

heroTalents.description: Wither damage increased 20%. When Wither gains a stack from Blackened Soul, it has a chance to gain an additional stack.
heroTalents.name: Bleakheart Tactics

heroTalents.description: Dark Pact heals you for 6,217 every 1 sec while active.
heroTalents.name: Zevrim's Resilience

heroTalents.description: Periodic damage dealt by Wither has a chance to grant Malevolence for 8 sec.
heroTalents.name: Devil Fruit

heroTalents.description:
Agony damage increased by 30%.

Blackened Soul deals 2% increased damage per stack of Wither.
heroTalents.name: Mark of Xavius

heroTalents.description:
After Wither reaches 8 stacks or when its host reaches 20% health, Wither deals 8,364 Shadowflame damage to its host every 1 sec until 1 stack remains.

When Blackened Soul deals damage, you have a chance to gain Shard Instability.
heroTalents.name: Seeds of Their Demise

heroTalents.description:
Damaging critical strikes dealt by Wither deal 215% damage instead of the usual 200%.

Damaging critical strikes dealt by Blackened Soul deal 225% damage instead of the usual 200%.
heroTalents.name: Mark of Peroth'arn

heroTalents.description: Malevolence grants an additional 4% Haste and when cast increases the stack count of active Withers by an additional 2 stacks.
heroTalents.name: Alzzin's Iniquity

heroTalents.description:
Dark magic erupts from you and corrupts your soul for 20 sec, causing enemies suffering from your Wither to take 39,395 Shadowflame damage and increase its stack count by 6.

While corrupted your Haste is increased by 8% and spending Soul Shards on damaging spells grants 1 additional stack of Wither.
heroTalents.name: Malevolence

specTalents.description: Unleashes a devastating blast of chaos, dealing a critical strike for 26,436 Chaos damage. Damage is further increased by your critical strike chance.
specTalents.name: Chaos Bolt

specTalents.description:
Triggers an explosion on the target, dealing 11,237 Fire damage.

Generates 5 Soul Shard Fragments.
specTalents.name: Conflagrate

specTalents.description:
Calls down a rain of hellfire the target location, dealing 17,838 Fire damage over 6.3 sec to enemies in the area.

This spell is cast at a selected location.
specTalents.name: Rain of Fire

specTalents.description: Conflagrate gains an additional charge.
specTalents.name: Improved Conflagrate

specTalents.description: Conflagrate reduces the cast time of your next Incinerate, Chaos Bolt, or Soul Fire by 30%. Maximum 2 charges.
specTalents.name: Backdraft

specTalents.description: Increases Mastery by 2%.
specTalents.name: Practiced Chaos

specTalents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Conflagrate by 2 sec.
specTalents.name: Explosive Potential

specTalents.description: Marks a target with Havoc for 15 sec, causing your single target spells to also strike the Havoc victim for 50% of the damage dealt.
specTalents.name: Havoc

specTalents.description: Increases the damage of Immolate by 25% and its duration by 3 sec.
specTalents.name: Scalding Flames

specTalents.description:
Blasts a target for 15,705 Shadowflame damage. Only usable on enemies that have less than 20% health.

Restores 1 Soul Shard and removes its cooldown if the target dies within 5 sec.
specTalents.name: Shadowburn

specTalents.description:
Increases your critical strike chance by 4%.

Physical attacks against you have a 40% chance to make your next Incinerate instant cast. This effect can only occur once every 6 sec.
specTalents.name: Backlash

specTalents.description: Chaos Bolt, Shadowburn, and Incinerate deal 6% increased damage to targets afflicted by Immolate.
specTalents.name: Ashen Remains

specTalents.description: Critical strikes dealt by Chaos Bolt, Conflagrate, or Incinerate have a 10% chance to make your next cast of Shadowburn within 30 sec cost no Soul Shards and usable on any target regardless of health.
specTalents.name: Fiendish Cruelty

specTalents.description: Increases Chaos Bolt damage by 5% and Chaos Bolt now has a 25% chance to make your next Incinerate instant.
specTalents.name: Chaotic Inferno

specTalents.description:
When your Immolate deals periodic damage to a target above 80% health, gain 2% Haste for 10 sec.

Stacks up to 3 times.
specTalents.name: Flashpoint

specTalents.description:
Summons an Infernal from the Twisting Nether, impacting for 1,825 Fire damage and stunning all enemies in the area for 2 sec.

The Infernal will serve you for 30 sec, dealing 1,766 damage to all nearby enemies every 1.6 sec and generating 1 Soul Shard Fragment every 1 sec.
specTalents.name: Summon Infernal

specTalents.description: Increases the damage done by your Fire spells by 2% and reduces the cast time of your Incinerate spell by 20%.
specTalents.name: Emberstorm

specTalents.description: Your spells have a chance to grant you 15% Haste for 8 sec.
specTalents.name: Reverse Entropy

specTalents.description: Increases the damage dealt by your spells and your demon by 3%.
specTalents.name: Summoner's Embrace

specTalents.description: Increases the critical strike damage of your Destruction spells by 30%.
specTalents.name: Ruin

specTalents.description: Increases the damage of Chaos Bolt by 10% and reduces its cast time by 0.5 sec.
specTalents.name: Improved Chaos Bolt

specTalents.description: Increases the critical strike chance of your Destruction spells by 6%.
specTalents.name: Devastation

specTalents.description:
Burns the enemy's soul, dealing 120,305 Fire damage and applying Immolate.

Generates 1 Soul Shard.
specTalents.name: Soul Fire

specTalents.description: Chaos Bolt, Rain of Fire, and Shadowburn always gain at least 70% of the maximum benefit from your Mastery: Chaotic Energies.
specTalents.name: Chaos Incarnate

specTalents.description: Conflagrate and Shadowburn have a 100% chance to critically strike and their damage is increased by your critical strike chance.
specTalents.name: Conflagration of Chaos

specTalents.description: Reduces the cooldown of Summon Infernal by 30.0 sec and increases your Mastery by 3%.
specTalents.name: Inferno

specTalents.description:
Casting Chaos Bolt, Shadowburn, or Rain of Fire evokes an echo of the Dark Titan's power at 50%, 50%, or 60% effectiveness respectively.

If no target is found, a random target suffering from your Immolate will be selected.
specTalents.name: Embers of Nihilam

specTalents.description: Memories of the Titans' destruction flash in your mind when you evoke the Dark Titan's power, increasing critical strike by 8% and haste by 8% for 6 sec.
specTalents.name: Embers of Nihilam

specTalents.description:
Casting Incinerate has a 10% chance to evoke an echo of the Dark Titan's power.

 Echo of Sargeras
Hurl an ember torn from Nihilam at the target, dealing 5,836 Shadowflame damage and an additional 5,058 Shadowflame damage to all enemies within 10 yds.

Damage reduced beyond 8 targets.
specTalents.name: Embers of Nihilam

specs.name: Destruction

pvpTalents.description:
Taking direct Physical damage reduces the cooldown of Demonic Circle by 3 sec.

Cannot occur more than once every 5 sec.
pvpTalents.name: Impish Instincts

pvpTalents.description: Surrounds the caster with a shield that lasts 3 sec, reflecting all harmful spells cast on you.
pvpTalents.name: Nether Ward

pvpTalents.description:
Fracture the soul of up to 3 target players within 20 yds into the shadows, reducing their damage done by 25% and healing received by 25% for 8 sec. Souls are fractured up to 20 yds from the player's location.

Players can retrieve their souls to remove this effect.
pvpTalents.name: Soul Rip

raids.description: The Dreamrift exists deep within the Rift of Aln, where the dreams of Aln'hara took form long ago. Dark manifestations have grown within the rift in Aln'hara's absence, devouring each other in an endless cycle. Even the brave haranir dare not delve too deep, for now something greater and more terrible lurks within the Dreamrift's depths.
raids.name: The Dreamrift
raids.title: The Dreamrift
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: From high above the Voidstorm, Xal'atath has gathered the Devouring Host beneath her dark banner. The towering Voidspire looms like a spear of darkness, a citadel guarded by an army of the void. The forces of the light - led by Alleria Windrunner and the Champions of Azeroth - must rally for one last desperate assault before all is lost.
raids.name: The Voidspire
raids.title: The Voidspire
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Darkness has eclipsed the Isle of Quel'Danas, clouding the skies above Silvermoon City. With Arator the Redeemer by their side, the Champions of Azeroth must march on the Sunwell before the light of the blood elves is lost forever.
raids.name: March on Quel'Danas
raids.title: March on Quel'Danas
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Deep in the fungal valleys of Harandar, the fungarian sporecallers have been growing a new threat for The Grudge Pit. Shaded by towering mushrooms, Sporefall is the perfect site to empower their new creation.
raids.name: Sporefall
raids.title: Sporefall
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Guided by the dark whispers of Malacrass, Zul'jan has freed the forgotten broods of Ula'tek from their prison. As the monster's power grows, Zul'jarra calls upon the Champions of Azeroth to descend into the Vaults of Atal'Utek to stop her brother before the weapon is unleashed upon Azeroth.
raids.name: The Venomous Abyss
raids.title: The Venomous Abyss
raids.subtitle: Level 90

raids.description: Hidden beneath the Vaults of Atal'Utek, Kith'ix was bound in his subterranean lair. With the defeat of Ula'tek, the restraints keeping Kith'ix at bay have weakened, unleashing the monstrosity the Amani locked away so long ago.
raids.name: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.title: The Unbinding of Kith'ix
raids.subtitle: Level 90

bossEncounters.description: This ravenous hydra has survived this cursed place through scavenging the meat of the fallen. That doesn't mean it is not a fearsome combatant, eager to add some fresh temple explorers to its otherwise rotting diet.
bossEncounters.name: Rav'i

bossEncounters.description: In the feeding frenzy upon each other, there has been one Child of Ula'tek that has proved victorious over the rest of the brood. With every battle won, the twisting monstrosity known as the Writhing Coil only grows stronger.
bossEncounters.name: The Writhing Coil

bossEncounters.description: With the Fang of Ula'tek, Zul'jan performs the final ritual to gain the power to release the monstrous weapon his ancestors sealed away thousands of years ago. Still held in the sway of the spirit of Malacrass, Zul'jan is unaware that the Fang is also the only hope for his sister Zul'jarra's survival.
bossEncounters.name: Zul'jan

dungeon.description: Upon the Altar of Fangs, the ancient Amani sealed the vaults of Atal'Utek with the Fang of Ula'tek. Only that cursed dagger has the power to unseal the prison of the great weapon of the Amani. Aid Orweyna and Liadrin in their pursuit of Zul'jan, who has entered this accursed place in a misbegotten attempt to bring lost glory back to the Amani.
dungeon.name: Altar of Fangs

bossEncounters.description: Although an accomplished Magister, Kystia Manaheart was far too devoted to fel magic to give it up entirely. Little wonder she's become a staunch supporter and ally to underground fel smuggling operations in the Row.
bossEncounters.name: Kystia Manaheart

bossEncounters.description: Clever, quick-witted and commanding, Zaen Bladesorrow oversees the shipments of illegal fel artifacts. Those under his command follow his orders to the letter... or pay the price.
bossEncounters.name: Zaen Bladesorrow

bossEncounters.description: Xathuux the Annihilator is one of Lithiel Cinderfury's most powerful summons. Although he loathes serving the warlock, he follows her commands for the sheer visceral joy of destruction.
bossEncounters.name: Xathuux the Annihilator

bossEncounters.description: Lithiel Cinderfury sees the Voidstorm above Silvermoon as both threat and opportunity. Her people are afraid, and she has a perfect solution... the power of fel. She claims her smuggling operation protects her people from the dangers above, but the profits she receives are a pleasing bonus.
bossEncounters.name: Lithiel Cinderfury

dungeon.description: The darkened streets of Murder Row hide a secret fel-smuggling operation that has been preying on the fears of Silvermoon's citizens ever since the Voidstorm appeared.
dungeon.name: Murder Row

bossEncounters.description: Driven by voracious greed, the gluttonous Hoardmonger fiercely defends the stashes of food and supplies he has stolen from nearby troll tribes. Nalorakk's first trial is to eliminate him before the tribes go hungry.
bossEncounters.name: The Hoardmonger

bossEncounters.description: The seasons can be kind or cruel. Sentinel of Winter unleashes the harshest of winter storms to test all who face him. To surpass Nalorakk's second trial, endure the biting cold and defeat the embodiment of a winter storm.
bossEncounters.name: Sentinel of Winter

bossEncounters.description: Slumbering in his fitful and battle-filled dream, Nalorakk, the Loa of War, will only test the mettle of the worthy. Survive his trial and receive his blessing or die trying.
bossEncounters.name: Nalorakk

dungeon.description: Wounded by Zul'jin and Malacrass, Nalorakk turned his back on the Amani, slumbering in his den to ease his pain. Now, the Amani seek to heal the rift between their tribe and the loa. But, to gain Nalorakk's favor, those who come before him must complete his trials. Assist Zul'jarra as she journeys into the mind of the Loa of War to defeat him and gain his blessing.
dungeon.name: Den of Nalorakk

bossEncounters.description: The domanaar's prized champion, Taz'Rah, is forced to fight against his will. Taz'Rah demands his own death from every opponent, hoping each battle will finally end his suffering.
bossEncounters.name: Taz'Rah

bossEncounters.description: Imprisoned by Charonus, this starving behemoth is hoping for a new victim to sate his appetite. Atroxus's sheer size is almost as dangerous as the poison he spews.
bossEncounters.name: Atroxus

bossEncounters.description: The overly confident and ostentatious owner of the Voidscar Arena, Charonus, is impressed by the fighting ability of Azerothians and demands them for his grand collection.
bossEncounters.name: Charonus

dungeon.description: The Voidscar Arena awaits worthy challengers! Overseer Charonus has filled the arena with opponents plucked from across Azeroth, forcing them to participate in his games.
dungeon.name: Voidscar Arena

bossEncounters.description: The Lightbloom has suffered a terrible defeat, but like the rutaani it imbues, it changes. These Lightblossomed rutaani fanatically propagate their vicious and invasive garden.
bossEncounters.name: Lightblossom Trinity

bossEncounters.description: Ikuzz is a fearsome carnivore who once stalked prey throughout Harandar. Now the Light Hunter has succumbed to the overwhelming power of the Lightbloom, and his insatiable hunger serves its growth.
bossEncounters.name: Ikuzz the Light Hunter

bossEncounters.description: The once-respected Rootwarden Ruia could not defeat the Lightbloom on his own. His wounded pride led him to drawing power from the Lightbloom and using it to punish all others instead of aiding his allies.
bossEncounters.name: Lightwarden Ruia

bossEncounters.description: Born from the Lightbloom's epicenter, Ziekket was spawned and incubated by Light-infested rutaani to create an unstoppable engine of the Lightbloom's expansion.
bossEncounters.name: Ziekket

dungeon.description:
The Blinding Vale sprouted instantly. From within the Lightbloom, rutaani emerged and spread the Lightbloom in their wake.
After the Lightbloom's defeat in Eversong, Orweyna began surgical strikes to keep the Lightbloom in check. But the hideous glare of the Blinding Vale hides a garden where the Lightbloom cultivates new creatures and magic to drive forward their one fanatical imperative. Growth unstoppable.
dungeon.name: The Blinding Vale

bossEncounters.description: Melidrussa Chillworn leads the Primalist infusion efforts in the Ruby Life Pools. Her fervent belief is that she is protecting young dragon eggs from the influence of the titans and cleansing them from the stain of Order magic. She will stop at nothing to fulfill her calling and return the eggs to what she believes is their natural state.
bossEncounters.name: Melidrussa Chillworn

bossEncounters.description: As Primalist forces assault the Ruby Life Pools from all sides, it falls to Kokia and her Blazebound lieutenants to capture precious eggs from overwhelmed defenders, all while spreading flame and havoc as they go.
bossEncounters.name: Kokia Blazehoof

bossEncounters.description: Kyrakka and Erkhart roam the skies above the Ruby Life Pools coordinating attacks on the shrine below, while also taking out any interfering dragons. If left unchecked, they will burn the Life Pools to the ground and blow the remaining ash away in a cleansing elemental storm.
bossEncounters.name: Kyrakka and Erkhart Stormvein

dungeon.description:
As the ancestral nesting grounds for the five flights, the Ruby Life Pools is a sacred place. The Red Dragonflight, whose charge it is to nuture all life, protect these pools and the the future of all dragonkind held within them.

However, Raszageth and her Primalists have come to steal that future away and infuse their own powers into the sacred pools. They must be stopped for dragonkind to thrive.
dungeon.name: Ruby Life Pools

bossEncounters.description: A pair of powerful sethrak that are blessed by the storm and charged with guarding the temple's entrance.
bossEncounters.name: Adderis and Aspix

bossEncounters.description: Merektha is the product of foul experiments to produce an army of unstoppable beasts. With her clutch of eggs beginning to hatch, this mother is on the hunt for victims to serve as food for her ravenous children.
bossEncounters.name: Merektha

bossEncounters.description: With the corruption of her temple, Sethraliss' command of lightning has created twisted elementals that roam the sunken chambers. Formed by this aberrant energy, Galvazzt seeks to grow in power by any means.
bossEncounters.name: Galvazzt

bossEncounters.description: The Heart of Sethraliss is in the grips of a terrible power that seeks to corrupt her. Her avatar must be restored before this evil takes root and she is reborn as a dark loa capable of destroying the whole of Vol'dun.
bossEncounters.name: Avatar of Sethraliss

dungeon.description: Centuries ago, Sethraliss, a powerful snake loa, sacrificed herself to stop Mythrax from unleashing his master upon Azeroth. After the battle, her devoted followers transported her remains and built a temple around them while they awaited her rebirth. Now, a dark force stirs within this sacred temple that seeks to twist her power towards nefarious ends.
dungeon.name: Temple of Sethraliss

bossEncounters.description: Kings' Rest has come under attack before. After a foolish troll tried to summon Hakkar the Soulflayer to this island many millennia ago, the priests of Zandalar created a mighty construct to defend this tomb. The Golden Serpent has stood against intruders ever since, judging who is worthy to enter these sacred halls.
bossEncounters.name: The Golden Serpent

bossEncounters.description: There was once a caste of Zandalari whose purpose was to preserve and defend the remains of past rulers. But when a terrible plague of corrupted blood tore through the empire, it was too risky for mortals to handle the dead. Golems were summoned for the grim work of preservation and burial; they have been used ever since.
bossEncounters.name: Mchimba the Embalmer

bossEncounters.description: There was once a time when no single emperor could rule Zandalar. After a period of civil war, the heads of three families formed an uneasy coalition and tried to rule the empire together. Though they did not often agree, there was peace in Zandalar. Briefly.
bossEncounters.name: The Council of Tribes

bossEncounters.description:
Dazar. The founder and first King of Zandalar, who led an exodus of his people out of the muck and mire and built a city of gold. The first tamer of raptors. The warrior undefeated. The father of a kingdom.

His eternal repose cut short by Zul's dark magic, it lies to you to once again put him to rest.
bossEncounters.name: Dazar, The First King

dungeon.description:
Few places in Zandalar are more sacred than Kings' Rest. Every king, conqueror, or tyrant who has held control of the Zandalari empire is housed within this great city of the dead to protect and honor not only their bodies, but also their spirits.

Entry has historically been restricted solely to the Zandalari priesthood and royalty, but as Zul's dark magic winds its way through the tomb you must venture inside and put an end to the darkness that has found purchase there.
dungeon.name: Kings' Rest
